market.summary: India had its best day in about a year: the Nifty rose 2.4% to 24,536.60 for a sixth straight gain, led by financials and autos, with crude lower on the week and foreign buying. But tonight the US reversed: chip and data-centre stocks are selling off after the Democrats' midterm win, and the Nasdaq is heading into a correction. Your holdings are domestic names with no chip exposure, so this is a risk to tomorrow's open, not to their business. Your stops are on a closing basis, so an opening dip alone decides nothing.

points.text: Sectors: Auto +4.14%, Financial Services +3.99%, Realty +3.52%; media and energy were relatively weak.

US at 9:57 am: Nasdaq -3.09%, S&P 500 -1.66%, Dow -0.66%; chip index -7.1%, Qualcomm -9% after missing smartphone chip estimates. The screener's later Yahoo reading had the Nasdaq -5.1% and VIX about 24; the US close was not known when this was written.
Brent back near $97 on 5 Nov after falling for four days; it was about $94 this morning.
FIIs net bought Rs 7,284 Cr on 4 Nov, a fourth straight day (the 5 Nov figure was not yet read). The rupee reached a two-week high.

market.watch: How much of the US tech fall reaches the 6 Nov open, the US jobs report on Friday, and Titan's reaction (profit +54%, filed after the close).

GROWW.summary: Groww closed +8.0% at Rs 223.89 on 3.2x volume, clearing +1R, so the plan's stop moves up from Rs 188.75 to your cost of Rs 200.80. I found no Groww-specific news or new filing; it moved with a strong day for financials, and the capital-markets group has had a tax-review tailwind since 3 Nov that is still only talk. This supports the PEAD drift. US broker peers were down sharply tonight, so a softer open would not be a surprise.

points.text: Close Rs 223.89 vs Rs 207.23, +1.92R; +2R is Rs 224.90. Swing and position stop Rs 200.80 (cost).
Finance Minister Sitharaman acknowledged investors' worries on equity taxation on 3 Nov but announced no change; listed long-term gains stay at 12.5%.
Nifty Financial Services +3.99% on 5 Nov.
US capital-markets peers averaged -5.2% at the screener's reading during the US session on 5 Nov.

GROWW.watch: A close at Rs 224.90 is +2R. A close under Rs 200.80 is the stop.

SEJALLTD.summary: The stock jumped back to Rs 884.90 from Rs 831.95, so yesterday's close under the Rs 838.03 stop has been reversed and the status is HOLD at about your cost. The bounce came on only 0.51x volume, with no new filing or news found, so it looks like the market's lift rather than fresh buying. The 4 Nov close did break the plan's stop, and whether to keep holding after that was your call. The monthly RSI warning stays.

points.text: No filing since the 27 Oct call transcript as of the 15:27 IST read; no bulk or block deal in 10 days.
Glass and building-products peers -0.8% on the last reading; Owens Corning's results were reported as a miss.

SEJALLTD.watch: A close under Rs 838.03 is the stop again; volume above average would give this bounce more weight.

THELEELA.summary: Leela closed +4.0% at Rs 689.75, a new closing high, on normal volume, and is now +2.7R with the trailing stop rising to Rs 618.12. The one report on the move credits momentum and names no corporate news. The move supports the PEAD drift. The 2 Nov investor-meet filing could still not be opened, so its content is unknown.

points.text: Close Rs 689.75 vs Rs 663.45; swing stop Rs 618.12 (21 EMA), position stop Rs 604.51 (cost). Delivery 46.6%.
The stock hit an all-time high on 5 Nov; the report cites technical strength and gives no news trigger. Its P/E is about 47x trailing earnings.
Brent rebounded towards $97 tonight, which trims the fuel-cost relief mentioned this morning.

THELEELA.watch: A close under Rs 618.12 is the swing stop; the price is about 12% above it..

INDHOTEL.summary: Indian Hotels closed +3.1% at Rs 875, a new closing high, on normal volume with 70.6% delivery, which points to real holding rather than quick trades. The trade is +1.97R, a rupee and a half short of +2R. Today's analyst meet has produced no filing as of the 15:27 IST read, so nothing from it is known. This supports the drift.

points.text: Close Rs 875 vs Rs 849; swing stop Rs 792.59 (21 EMA), position stop Rs 785.83 (cost); +2R Rs 876.55.
Selling-pressure read: accumulation, last 25 sessions 6 accumulation days vs 2 distribution days. The weekly RSI is overbought (about 75 at the last reading): a caution, not an exit.

INDHOTEL.watch: Any filing or presentation from the analyst meet; a close under Rs 792.59 is the swing stop.

TIPSMUSIC.summary: Tips fell 2.9% to Rs 763.50 on a day the Nifty rose 2.4%, though on just 0.39x volume, so it looks more like no buyers than heavy selling. Media was among the weak groups today. No new filing or news was found. The trade is +0.54R with the stop above cost, so the risk is giving back profit rather than a loss.

points.text: Close Rs 763.50 vs Rs 786.55; peak close Rs 793.90; swing stop Rs 739.95, position stop Rs 727.89 (cost).
Media and energy were the relatively weak sectors on 5 Nov.
Over the last 5 sessions to 4 Nov it lagged NIFTY MEDIA by 6.9 points.

TIPSMUSIC.watch: A close under Rs 739.95 is the swing stop, about 3% away.

BHAGERIA.summary: The stock rose 4.3% to Rs 369.70, back above the Rs 360.01 stop, so yesterday's exit signal is off and the status is HOLD, slightly above cost. Volume was below average at 0.87x and no new filing or news was found, so this is the market's lift rather than company news. The 4 Nov close did break the plan's stop, and holding on after that was your call. The stop is close, so a weak open can test it again.

points.text: Close Rs 369.70 vs Rs 354.35; entry Rs 367.46, stop Rs 360.01, +1R Rs 374.91; +0.3R.
Global chemical peers averaged +2.0% on the screener's last reading.
Last company filing is the 28 Oct results; the SEBI matter stays adjourned to 5 Jan 2027, as noted earlier.

BHAGERIA.watch: A close under Rs 360.01 is the stop; a close at or above Rs 374.91 is +1R.
